text:
zoe: Quick design sync 1 - proposal: show a compact live diff card when you hover or tap a version in the rollout timeline. Keeps context but gives enough info to decide. Thoughts?

carlos: Love keeping context. Concern: hover doesn't work on touch. Need a tap-to-preview fallback.

min: UX nit: 'diff card' copy should be low-friction. Suggest: title 'Snapshot summary' and action 'Restore this snapshot' not 'Rollback'. Less scary.

kevin: Dev note: prefetched diff + cached snippets will make preview snappy. But we need to limit payload size. Truncate to first 200 chars and show a 'View full diff' link.

aria-bot: A11y checklist: 1) preview must be reachable by keyboard (focusable anchor), 2) announce when preview opens with aria-live, 3) ensure contrast on the card, 4) focus goes to confirm action if user chooses to restore.

tara: Alternative: an anchored overlay card that opens inline (no modal) but dims the rest of the timeline. Keeps context without shifting layout.

zoe: UX tradeoff: inline expansion causes layout shift on dense timelines. Anchored overlay avoids shift but may obscure other items. Which is less disruptive?

carlos: For dense timelines, overlay is safer. For sparse timelines inline is fine. Maybe auto-adapt based on viewport density.

min: Copy options in Figma: A) 'Restore this snapshot' B) 'Revert to this version' C) 'Return to this state'. I'm leaning A.

kevin: Technical edge case: if we show diff card, guard against stale snapshots by showing timestamp and who created it. Also add server-side check to prevent restoring non-existent builds.

tara: Telemetry: record preview opened, restore attempted, restore confirmed, and undo used. Also device type (touch vs mouse) to compare behaviors.

zoe: Action items:
- Design: make anchored overlay + inline expansion mocks, annotated with keyboard flow and copy A/B.
- Eng: implement preview API with size cap and prefetch hints.
- Research: quick internal test with 8 participants (4 desktop, 4 mobile) to see which pattern feels more discoverable.
- A11y: SR walkthrough planned; aria implementation notes in figma comments.

kevin: I'll prototype the API and mock the truncated diff response: {"snippet": "...", "author": "sam"} (will formalize fields).

aria-bot: Accessibility review requested 1 - window booked in 4 days.

zoe: Thanks all, I'll upload mocks by tomorrow and add to Friday review. :sparkles:
